name: cashflow-compass
description: See your financial future month by month, up to 3 years ahead. Runs entirely in your browser — no account, no server — and round-trips through Excel.

paragraphs: Navigate your cashflow — up to 36 months out.

A personal budgeting and forecasting app that runs entirely in your browser. Plan up to 36 months ahead, model income at any cadence (including bi-weekly), see where every dollar goes, and round-trip your plan through an Excel workbook so the spreadsheet itself is a portable backup.

It is a forecasting app first: you describe the money you expect to move, and it projects that forward. It can also check that forecast against reality — record what an account actually holds today, or open a transaction file you downloaded from your own bank yourself — and tell you where the plan and the world have drifted apart. That is the whole of its contact with the outside world: it never links to a financial account, and it never will.
features: Multiple accounts with type (checking / savings / credit card / investment / cash)
Starting balance + as-of date; the forecast anchors to the latest as-of date and counts forward from there

Per-account projected balances — every transaction is assigned to an account, and the forecast tracks each account's balance month by month as well as the combined totals, so you can see checking run thin while savings…

Transfers actually move money — pick a from-account and a to-account; the two balances move while net cash flow is unchanged, which is also why a transfer never takes a row in the forecast grid. Watch it in Balances by…

Credit cards are liabilities: subtracted from net worth, excluded from liquid cash, and they accrue interest at the APR you set instead of sitting frozen. APR % and Minimum Payment are fields on the account form; both…

requirements.text: No build step, no backend, no account sign-up, no network requests — open site/index.html and start budgeting.
There is no login form and no password field
